verdict.rationale: The Paychex developer overview has a 'Versioning' section alongside 'Vendor Media Type', so the API documents its own versioning scheme. The evidence is only a section heading, and nothing shows a deprecation policy, sunset timelines or change notices. missing for 10: documented deprecation policy, details of the versioning scheme (e.g. media-type version negotiation), sunset/notice timelines, changelog, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
